coverage.interaction: Render enabled action controls and preserve their native button and menuitem semantics.
coverage.test: renders action-family primitives as accessible light DOM

coverage.interaction: Move the pointer onto and away from an action without changing layout.
coverage.reason: No browser assertion drives pointer hover and compares the action treatment or geometry.

coverage.interaction: Move keyboard focus to an action and retain a visible focus indicator.
coverage.test: reflects action, loading, disabled, expanded, selected, and focus states on native controls

coverage.interaction: Activate an action and prove the active treatment preserves readable contrast.
coverage.reason: Click payload coverage exists, but no browser assertion observes active-state presentation.

coverage.interaction: Disable an action and remove native activation.
coverage.test: reflects action, loading, disabled, expanded, selected, and focus states on native controls

coverage.interaction: Mark an action busy while preserving its accessible name and control dimensions.
coverage.test: reflects action, loading, disabled, expanded, selected, and focus states on native controls

coverage.interaction: Render input primitives as their native accessible controls.
coverage.test: renders input-family MVP primitives as native accessible controls

coverage.interaction: Move the pointer onto and away from an input without changing layout.
coverage.reason: No browser assertion drives pointer hover over an input control.

coverage.interaction: Move keyboard focus between input controls and retain a visible focus indicator.
coverage.reason: The focus-visible harness is covered, but no input-family test invokes it.

coverage.interaction: Disable form controls and prevent native interaction.
coverage.test: reflects form disabled, invalid, required, readonly, checked, and indeterminate states

coverage.interaction: Mark an input busy while preserving its label, value, and dimensions.
coverage.reason: No input primitive currently mirrors loading or busy state in a browser assertion.

coverage.interaction: Open and close a select-like disclosure and mirror its expanded state.
coverage.reason: Native select rendering is covered, but no disclosure transition or aria-expanded assertion exists.

coverage.interaction: Reflect validation failure and retain help and error relationships.
coverage.test: reflects form disabled, invalid, required, readonly, checked, and indeterminate states

coverage.interaction: Expose required semantics through native controls and their accessible labels.
coverage.test: reflects form disabled, invalid, required, readonly, checked, and indeterminate states

coverage.interaction: Keep a readonly field focusable and submittable while preventing edits.
coverage.test: reflects form disabled, invalid, required, readonly, checked, and indeterminate states

coverage.interaction: Mirror authored checked state to native checkbox, radio, and switch controls.
coverage.test: reflects form disabled, invalid, required, readonly, checked, and indeterminate states

coverage.interaction: Expose mixed aggregate selection through native or ARIA state.
coverage.test: reflects form disabled, invalid, required, readonly, checked, and indeterminate states

coverage.interaction: Render navigation landmarks and a labeled tablist with native roles.
coverage.test: renders navigation-family MVP primitives as accessible landmarks and tablists

coverage.interaction: Move the pointer across navigation items without changing layout.
coverage.reason: No navigation browser assertion drives pointer hover.

coverage.interaction: Move keyboard focus through navigation items with a visible focus indicator.
coverage.reason: Navigation roles are covered, but their focus-visible treatment is not asserted.

coverage.interaction: Activate a navigation item while retaining selection and readable contrast.
coverage.reason: No browser assertion performs a navigation activation transition.

coverage.interaction: Disable a navigation item and remove activation and tab-stop behavior where appropriate.
coverage.reason: No disabled navigation item is asserted in the browser suite.

coverage.interaction: Distinguish the selected tab from its unselected peer through ARIA state.
coverage.test: reflects action, loading, disabled, expanded, selected, and focus states on native controls

coverage.interaction: Open and close a navigation group and mirror disclosure state with aria-expanded.
coverage.reason: The suite asserts menu-item expansion, but no navigation group owns an expanded transition.

coverage.interaction: Render token-scoped layout containers with their authored structure and spacing metadata.
coverage.test: renders layout, list, navigation, surface, and dialog shell primitives

coverage.interaction: Mark a layout region busy while preserving its dimensions and child placement.
coverage.reason: No layout primitive exposes or asserts loading/busy state.

coverage.interaction: Render an empty layout region with visible guidance and a next action path.
coverage.reason: No layout workflow asserts an empty region or recovery action.

coverage.interaction: Render content primitives with their semantic roles, labels, and projected content.
coverage.test: renders content-family MVP primitives as accessible light DOM

coverage.interaction: Move the pointer over an interactive content row or chip without changing layout.
coverage.reason: No content browser assertion drives pointer hover.

coverage.interaction: Move keyboard focus to interactive content with a visible focus indicator.
coverage.reason: No content-family test invokes the focus-visible harness.

coverage.interaction: Select a content row or chip and distinguish it from hover and keyboard focus.
coverage.test: selects declarative list options without changing passive list semantics

coverage.interaction: Mark content busy while preserving dimensions and an accessible loading status.
coverage.reason: Feedback progress/skeleton coverage exists, but no content primitive owns a loading assertion.

coverage.interaction: Render visible empty-state content when a list or table has no projected items.
coverage.test: preserves empty states, indeterminate progress, and live-region roles

coverage.interaction: Toggle a filter chip and mirror checked and selected treatment.
coverage.test: toggles checkable content chips without changing passive chip semantics

coverage.interaction: Render feedback surfaces with their native dialog, region, progress, and live-region semantics.
coverage.test: renders feedback-family MVP primitives with status and dialog semantics

coverage.interaction: Move keyboard focus into a feedback surface and retain a visible focus indicator.
coverage.reason: Dialog and sheet semantics are asserted, but focus movement and indication are not.

coverage.interaction: Expose indeterminate progress and an inert visual placeholder with an accessible loading label.
coverage.test: preserves empty states, indeterminate progress, and live-region roles

coverage.interaction: Open and close a dialog or sheet and mirror disclosure state where applicable.
coverage.reason: Feedback surfaces render, but no open/close transition or aria-expanded owner is asserted.

coverage.interaction: Render validation feedback with urgent semantics and an error treatment.
coverage.test: preserves empty states, indeterminate progress, and live-region roles
